item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We oppose commercial deep-sea mining because it will permanently destroy deep-ocean ecosystems. The seafloor is not a sacrifice zone. We must stop this destructive industry before it starts.

2. If commercial deep-sea mining begins, ancient habitats will be crushed, species will be wiped out, and deep-ocean ecosystems will be permanently destroyed. We choose protection—not irreversible damage for corporate profit.

3. We cannot restore an ecosystem that took millions of years to develop. Commercial deep-sea mining will cause permanent destruction. We demand that governments keep industrial machinery out of the deep ocean.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are drawing a clear line: commercial deep-sea mining must not begin. If corporations send industrial machinery into the deep ocean, they will permanently destroy ecosystems that have developed over millions of years. No profit can justify grinding up the seafloor, wiping out habitats, and disrupting living systems we are only beginning to understand. The deep ocean is not an empty sacrifice zone; it is a vital, interconnected world that sustains life far beyond its depths. We refuse to accept irreversible destruction as the price of minerals. Together, we can demand an end to this reckless industry before it starts and protect the deep ocean for every generation to come.
